race.description: The Bellevue Hotel Golden Mile Showcase Hcp (C2)
race.comment: UNREAL EXPECTATION (1) has not won for some time, though he did just miss by a short head when resuming in June. He is down in class from his last start when finishing runner-up as the favourite, and Aaron Bullock will give him every chance to break that win drought in this. ERINA (2) found the front at Newcastle-Beaumont last start and kept on fighting to score comfortably by well over a length. The step up to a mile will be no problem, and similar tactics could be the way to go again. BROADWAY FOLLIES (5) dropped down to country class at Taree and found some form again when finishing third there 11 days ago. She tries 1600m for the first time and should hold her form now. Stick with her. SUPER SUGOI (4) appreciated getting out to a mile when finishing runner-up at Scone 10 days ago, and even from a wide gate, he can figure in the top 4 again. PELEVECCHIO (8) needed her resuming run over 1350m, and the extra 250m will suit her, as will the pole position. Keep her safe.
